about: A view that cannot be turned. The camera template is switched to the 2.5D camera with scene_set_camera {fixedView: {yaw: 0, pitch: 20}}: the player moves the mouse far to the right at second 3 and to the left and down at 8 (look inputs), walks right from 5 and towards the camera from 9.5. The four screenshots (2, 4.5, 7.5, 11) must show the walls from the same side at the same angle: only the character has moved.
